title: release: add release manifests, provenance export and cosign signing to Private Installer CI
author: Asha Patel
ci_status: pass (all checks green after one flaky cosign verification retry)
description: Motivation: Customers running Redwood Private use the private-installer release artifacts in air-gapped environments; we must produce deterministic release manifests, signed artifacts, and provenance metadata so operators can verify integrity offline. This PR adds a release-manifests pipeline, SBOM/provenance generation (syft), and cosign signing integration to the private-installer CI. Changes include generation of per-arch tarballs, a canonical release-manifests JSON blob with artifact hashes and build metadata, Syft SBOMs (json and spdx), and Cosign signatures published to the release bucket. The pipeline is gated behind a new release workflow that runs on tag pushes and release creation. Checklist: - [x] generate tarballs for linux/amd64, linux/arm64 - [x] produce syft SBOMs and include them in manifests - [x] compute sha256/sha512 for all artifacts and include build metadata (git SHA, builder image) - [x] sign artifacts and manifests with cosign and upload public signatures - [x] add verification steps to CI (cosign verify, sbom schema check) - [x] add Terraform module bump for release-bucket lifecycle rules - [x] update docs/RELEASE.md with verification steps Non-goals: this PR does not add automated key management (KMS/HSM) rotation policies; that will be handled in a follow-up (ENG-1907). Testing: ran the full release pipeline in a staging project (release-staging-01) including offline verification: downloaded artifacts, verified hashes, and validated cosign signatures using the published public key. Impact: enables reproducible, verifiable releases for private-installer customers and prepares us for compliance audits. Rolling forward: once merged, the release pipeline will be enabled for v1.8 tags and backported to release/v1.7 in a separate PR.
commits: Add release manifest generator script; Add syft sbom generation step; Integrate cosign signing and signature upload; Add terraform module bump for release bucket lifecycle and policy; Add CI verification job and docs update
changed_files: ci/workflows/release.yml, scripts/generate-release-manifests.sh, scripts/generate-sbom.sh, ci/steps/cosign-verify.sh, helm/private-installer/Chart.yaml (version bump), terraform/modules/release-bucket/main.tf (lifecycle rules), docs/RELEASE.md, manifests/release-manifests-v1.json.template

Liam: requested additional integration test to verify sbom schema, CI added a sbom-schema-check step. CI initially failed on cosign verify due to a transient network error; re-run succeeded. Final reviews: Daniel approved, Sofia approved, Liam approved.
ci_checks: ci/unit: pass, ci/integration: pass, ci/release: pass (cosign sign -> upload -> verify), lint: pass, sbom-schema-check: pass, e2e: pass (staging), security-scan: pass
release_notes: Adds reproducible release-manifests and signed artifacts for the Private Installer. Generates SBOMs (Syft), publishes cosign signatures, and includes artifact provenance metadata in release-manifests. Improves security and auditability for air-gapped/private deployments.
